verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਹਥਿ ਜੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਲੈ ਸਭਿ ਰਾਗ ਵਜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: jiau ja(n)tree hath ja(n)tr lai sabh raag vajaae|

en.bdb: The Lord resembles to an instrumentalist who holding the instrument in his hand plays all the different measures on it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਗਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: aape sun sun magan hoi aape gun gaae|

en.bdb: Listening to the tunes played he remain immersed in them and eulogises the Supreme.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਪਿ ਰੀਝਿ ਰੀਝਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv leen hoi aap reejh reejhaae|

en.bdb: Merging his consciousness in the Word he becomes elated and makes others also delighted.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਥਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: kathataa bakataa aap hai surataa liv laae|

en.bdb: Lord is the speaker as well as the listener immersed in super consciousness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਰਬੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: aape hee visamaadh hoi saraba(n)g samaae|

en.bdb: Himself all bliss He premeates one and all.
This mystery that the Lord is omnipresent, is only understood by a gurmukh, the Guru oriented one.
